verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches this story: IAM policies govern control of resources within OCI tenancies, and budgets with alerts provide soft spending guardrails. Neither describes a multi-project isolation pattern that keeps experiments away from prod. Missing for 10: documented compartment/organization/child-tenancy isolation patterns, sandbox or dev-vs-prod separation guidance, hard guardrails (quotas, policy enforcement across units), and any independent corroboration.
